comparisons.label: lower_soft_vs_backfill
comparisons.interpretation: Amortized cost does not keep a single robust sign once the repeated evidence is summarized by both median and trimmed mean. Candidate-fraction and candidate-count reduction both remain robust. Retrieval-search cost still changes sign across the repeated evidence. Route-query also contributes robustly. Top-1 deltas remain small and mixed.

comparisons.label: lower_continuous_vs_backfill
comparisons.interpretation: Amortized cost stays robustly favorable under both median and trimmed-mean summaries. Candidate-fraction and candidate-count reduction both remain robust. Retrieval-search cost still changes sign across the repeated evidence. Top-1 deltas remain small and mixed.

comparisons.label: upper_soft_vs_backfill
comparisons.interpretation: Amortized cost stays robustly favorable under both median and trimmed-mean summaries. Candidate-fraction and candidate-count reduction both remain robust. Retrieval-search cost remains a robust part of the advantage. Route-query also contributes robustly. Top-1 deltas remain small and mixed.

comparisons.label: upper_continuous_vs_backfill
comparisons.interpretation: Amortized cost stays robustly favorable under both median and trimmed-mean summaries. Candidate-fraction and candidate-count reduction both remain robust. Retrieval-search cost remains a robust part of the advantage. Top-1 deltas remain small and mixed.

overall_read: Robust systems promotion survives for lower_continuous_vs_backfill, upper_soft_vs_backfill, upper_continuous_vs_backfill. Stable pruning survives but wallclock stays mixed for lower_soft_vs_backfill.
